context: TodoList manages an array of todo items in state. Items can be added and toggled between done/not-done.
explanation: Both addTodo and toggleTodo mutate the existing state array (push, direct property assignment) and pass the same reference to setTodos. React sees the same object reference and skips the re-render — the UI never updates. Fix: create new arrays and objects via spread or map so React detects a state change.
